mainEntity.name: What is an offshore development centre?

acceptedAnswer.text: An offshore development centre is a dedicated engineering team in another country, here India, that works exclusively for one client under that client's direction, while the partner handles hiring, facilities, HR and operations.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between offshore and outsourcing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Project outsourcing hands over a defined piece of work. Offshore development gives you a long-term team you direct, much like an internal department, with lower cost.

mainEntity.name: How big does an offshore team need to be?

acceptedAnswer.text: Teams can start with two or three engineers and grow as the roadmap expands.

mainEntity.name: Can we take over the team later?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Under a build-operate-transfer model, Ladder7 sets up and runs the team, then transfers it to your own legal entity.

Offshore delivery models

content.text: Location advantages
Why Kerala for offshore development
Kerala combines established IT parks, high literacy and lower attrition than India's largest metros. Ladder7's offices are in Kinfra Film and IT Park, Trivandrum, and WEE SPACES, Kochi.
Lower operating costs than Bengaluru, Pune or Hyderabad.
Strong English communication and a large graduate pool.
Direct flights from Kochi and Trivandrum to Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Doha, Riyadh, Muscat and other Gulf cities.
